question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (SpaceX)

calls.reasoning: SpaceX reports Q3 FY2026 on Oct 20. Bloomberg consensus is ~$0.14-0.15 EPS (labelled adjusted) on $12.9B revenue, with a Citi high of $0.18 and some estimates near $0.23. Q2 GAAP diluted EPS was -$0.09 on 5.86B weighted shares, and that GAAP figure is what consensus was compared against. Q3 has a full quarter of post-IPO share count (~6.5B) and interest income on ~$93B of cash, but faces heavy AI spending and depreciation, possible post-IPO stock-compensation charges, and other GAAP-only items. I put the median slightly under consensus for GAAP-vs-adjusted risk and kept wide tails because the company's history is short and Q2 surprised by 0.17. I searched for a prediction market (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold) and found none.
calls.dossier:
- SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) reports Q3 FY2026 Tue Oct 20, 2026, with a webcast at 3:30pm CT (driveteslacanada, tipranks, Oct 2026).
- Consensus (Bloomberg via Pepperstone, Oct 2026): revenue $12.89B (+65% QoQ), adjusted EPS $0.149, EBITDA $6.62B, capex $19.61B. Benzinga/TipRanks: EPS $0.14; Citi $0.18; some estimates near $0.23. Yahoo: AI revenue ~$6.4B expected; Starlink op profit $1.66B on $4.45B revenue.
- Q2 2026 10-Q (SEC): net loss $541M, basic and diluted EPS -$0.09 on 5.864B weighted shares. Consensus had been -$0.26, a beat of +0.17. The six-month net loss was $4.817B (-$1.12/share on 4.879B shares), so Q1 had a very large loss of roughly -$4.3B.
- IPO in June 2026: 638.9M Class A shares at $135, net proceeds $85.7B; cash $93.5B at June 30. Q3 is the first full quarter at the higher share count (~6.5B) and with interest income on that cash.
- Q2 AI segment operating loss $1.26B; AI capex $15.8B in Q2. A $20B bridge loan matures Sep 2027 (Pepperstone, Yahoo).
- Q3 would be the first positive quarter since IPO if consensus holds. Q3 events: Starship reached orbit; ~$8B Grain spectrum deal announced (InvestorsHub, Oct 19).
- Resolution instrument: resolves off GAAP diluted EPS in the Q3 earnings release/8-K, not adjusted EPS. Some previews label the consensus 'adjusted'; for Q2, GAAP diluted EPS matched the headline figure (-0.09).
- Event window: Q3 release expected Oct 20, 2026, the first report after Sep 30, 2026; as of Oct 19 21:52 UTC the release is less than 1 day away.
- Searched for but not found: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold markets on this EPS; explicit GAAP-vs-non-GAAP reconciliation guidance for Q3; the dispersion of individual analyst EPS estimates.

calls.reconciliation: Runs agreed on all core facts (Q2 GAAP -0.09, consensus 0.14-0.15 labelled adjusted, release Oct 20, no market). Disputes: share count (6.5B vs 8.1B vs 13.18B) is factual but cannot be settled without web access; it widens dispersion but consensus per-share presumably uses the correct base. GAAP-vs-adjusted gap and whether the Q2 beat signals persistent conservatism are judgment calls; I weight the Cursor-acquisition GAAP charges (closed Aug 14, documented in Run 3) more than the one-quarter beat history, putting the median slightly below consensus at 0.125, between Runs 1/3 and 2/4 on evidence rather than by averaging.
